subject: Urgent: Private VPC hotfix release & version-freeze coordination
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: ops@kestrel-finance.com, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Private VPC hotfix release & version-freeze coordination

Hi team —

We discovered a CVE affecting the on-prem connector used by Kestrel's Private deployment (see JIRA OPS-4821). Engineering has a patch build (v1.2.1) that fixes the issue but it requires a coordinated, pinned release across the VPC nodes and a short maintenance window to rotate replicas and warm caches.

Goals for this thread:
- Lock a version-freeze window for Private nodes (pin current runtime to 1.2.1 for rollout)
- Define staggered maintenance windows by region/cluster to keep fallbacks healthy
- Agree on rollback criteria and a short rollback playbook (attached)
- Confirm preflight checks and who signs the go/no-go

Proposed rough schedule (subject to Kestrel ops):
1) Canary (1 node) — Tue 2027-08-04 01:00–01:30 UTC
2) Small batch (10%) — Tue 2027-08-04 03:00–04:00 UTC
3) Full rollout (remaining) — Wed 2027-08-04 23:00–02:00 UTC

Attachments: release_notes_1.2.1.pdf, rollback_playbook.md, preflight-checklist.csv
JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OPS-4821
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/ABCD-hotfix-v1.2.1

Markus, Monica — can you review the gating checks (latency, token throughput, cache hit%) and add any infra/network items we should pre-approve?
Kestrel ops — please confirm preferred maintenance windows and whether you need a blackout period.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Platform Ops Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Private VPC hotfix release & version-freeze coordination

Tessa —

Quick read: looks good. A few items to add to the gate checklist:
- Pre-patch baseline: 95th and 99th latency samples for the last 72h (we should capture this 1 hour before canary)
- KV cache cold-start prediction (estimate extra token cost for first 30 minutes)
- Health probe thresholds — if the readiness probe fails 3x in a row, automatic stop of rollout
- DB connection pool behavior — some customers run connection pooling proxies that react badly to mass restarts; add a slow-drain step (30s) per replica.

Also recommend we require a signed "go" from Kestrel's infra lead before moving from canary to small-batch. Monica, can you draft the short 'stop-and-rollback' checklist in the playbook (I added a placeholder in rollback_playbook.md)?

I'll loop in Karthik for the VPC routing/peer considerations — don't want BGP flaps during the restart window.

-markus

On a process note: pinning the runtime version at 1.2.1 is fine, but we should publish the pin in the deployment manifest and keep the previous version available for immediate fallback.

From: Ops Team <ops@kestrel-finance.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: kira@cloudhaven.io
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 15:46:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: Private VPC hotfix release & version-freeze coordination

Tessa / Redwood team —

Thanks for the heads up. We can accommodate maintenance windows but prefer local times between 01:00–05:00 UTC to minimize business impact. The canary + small-batch schedule you proposed looks acceptable. A couple of questions:

1) Version pinning: will the nodes be pinned at container/image tag 1.2.1 and require a manual unpin to go back to 1.2.0? We have automation that respects the manifest, so need clarity on who flips the pin.
2) Rollback RTO/RPO: what's your expected recovery time if the rollback path is taken? We need this for our compliance team.

We also ask for a 48-hour notice before any large restarts so we can schedule dependent jobs.

-kestrel ops (Sara)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 02:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Private VPC hotfix release & version-freeze coordination

Thanks — a few network/ops notes from my side before we lock windows:
- BGP / eBGP peer churn: during node restarts we may see transient route reconvergence. Recommend maintaining an extra standby node in each cluster during the window to avoid capacity loss.
- Load balancer drain settings: set drain timeout to 45s (default is 5s) to allow long requests to finish.
- NAT gateway scaling: confirm that SNAT port exhaustion isn't possible during simultaneous restarts (I added a check in the preflight checklist).
- Canary scope: test across two availability subnets (not just one) to surface any subnet ACL or SG differences for Kestrel's VPC.

Rollbacks:
- Our rollback playbook will restore the previous image tag (1.2.0) and restore the KV caches from snapshots taken immediately prior to canary start. Snapshot/restore time will be the dominant factor — estimate 6–12 minutes per node for cache reload depending on compaction.
- If latency / error rate spikes >2x baseline for >5 minutes post-small-batch, we trigger an immediate rollback.

I'll be online for the canary window; can confirm LT/HT zero-downtime settings with Cloudhaven if Kestrel needs.

-karthik

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: ops@kestrel-finance.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Private VPC hotfix release & version-freeze coordination

Thanks everyone — finalizing schedule and next steps below. Kestrel ops confirmed preferred UTC window.

Final plan (confirmed):
- Notice period: 48h (this email serves as initial notification)
- Preflight runbook: run our script in preflight-checklist.csv and attach outputs to OPS-4821
- Canary: 2027-08-06 01:00–01:30 UTC (single node, cross-subnet)
- Small-batch: 2027-08-06 03:00–04:00 UTC (10%) — require Kestrel infra "GO" in Slack #kestrel-ops
- Full rollout: 2027-08-06 23:00–02:00 UTC (staggered groups with 15m gap between groups)

Pinned behavior: deployment manifests will pin the image tag to 1.2.1. Reverting to 1.2.0 requires manual update of the manifest; Redwood will perform that update if rollback criteria met and Kestrel ops approves.

Rollback criteria (summary):
- Error rate >= 2x baseline for >5 minutes post-batch
- 95th latency >= 2x baseline for >5 minutes
- Readiness failures >= 3 successive probes per replica

Owners:
- Redwood execution lead: Tessa Morgan (I'm primary during window)
- Network lead: Karthik Iyer (routing/BGP & drain settings)
- Infra gating: Markus Klein (release gatekeeper)
- Kestrel approver: Sara from Kestrel ops (ops@kestrel-finance.com)

Next actions:
1) Kestrel to confirm final OK on 2027-08-06 windows (reply-all)
2) Markus/Monica update rollback_playbook.md with the stop-and-rollback script and attach outputs to OPS-4821
3) Karthik to run NAT/SNAT preflight and share results in the drive folder

I'll create a short incident channel for the window and post the final checklist. Appreciate the quick turns here — tagging the related links and attachments again.

Attachments: release_notes_1.2.1.pdf, rollback_playbook.md, preflight-checklist.csv

Tessa
Platform Ops Lead — Redwood Inference
